message: Happy Happy Birthday!

name: Synn
message: 「...Yeah, looking good」
In the hand mirror was a handsome guy.
My grooming is flawless!

name: Paqy
message: 「Getting all dressed up for once--what's the occasion?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing looks weird, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're acting pretty suspicious, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just being sharp.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Answering with a straight face--that's our Demon Lord for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, I'm so nervous...」
To think Melilot-san would call me over for something other than helping with librarian duties...
Come to think of it, I kinda feel like there was an unusual vibe between us yesterday, too...
What if we end up alone together...
We might just take things to the next level, moving past our relationship as librarian and mere student!

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun... Um, actually, I...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san, I've felt the same way about you for a long time...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Aah, Sakura-kun! I can't hold back anymore!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Me neither...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I've wanted you for so long, it's been aching inside...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll comfort you right now...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm so happy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Uooooh! Cast off!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Aah, how rugged and manly...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee! Sakura Sting!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ahaaaa~~~n\s05」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, no, no!」

name: Synn
message: 「What am I even expecting...」
Still, either way, it's a fact that she has some kind of business with me.
Which means we're going to have to spend time together....
My heart is pounding uncontrollably, and I can't calm down.
Even so, I can't just keep hesitating like this....

name: Synn
message: 「...Alright」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「H-H-H-H-Hello!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You actually came, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yesh!」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Um, is something the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, no! It's nothing at all! I can hold it in!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so...?」
No good, no good. Let's calm down.
At this rate, she's going to think I'm a weirdo.

name: Melilot
message: 「So, I'm terribly sorry after calling you out here myself, but」

name: Synn
message: 「Did something inconvenient come up...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. It's just that I'd like you to wait until closing time」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah! That's no trouble at all」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd like, I can help out, though」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please don't trouble yourself. Today, it is my job, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「The thought alone is more than enough」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's one of my few redeeming qualities, so please don't take it away from me」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Understood...」
I wanted to try doing librarian work together with her, though....
Well, when she puts it like that, there's no helping it.

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll just look some things up while I wait」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes」
Melilot-san is as composed and unguarded as ever.
So this is what adult poise looks like...!
I need to calm my heart down a little too....

name: Synn
message: 「Mghh...」
The more conscious of it I became, the more my worldly desires spurred on!

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Melilot-san... Is it closing time already?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, I'm sorry to have kept you waiting」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, not at all」
Even if it takes a whole day, this heart of mine probably won't quiet down.

name: Melilot
message: 「Well then, shall we go?」
Where we're heading is, of course, Melilot-san's room....
Is our private mystery tour for two finally about to begin...!

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, right this way...」

name: Helena
message: 「Yaho~~o♪ Congrats, Synn-cha~n♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「Congratulations, Synn-sama」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Wha!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Hold on, you two, haven't you made way too much of a mess...?」

name: Helena
message: 「What are you talking about? Times like this are exactly when we gotta go all out!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the cleaning up to me, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Melilot
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san, what is all this...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah, right. I forgot to mention」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun」

name: Melilot
message: 「Happy birthday to you」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, today is my birthday...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, it is. This is a celebration for it」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan, did you actually forget your own birthday?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I didn't have any room to even think about that...」
My mind had been completely occupied by distracting thoughts.

name: Synn
message: 「How utterly embarrassing...」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, what kind of embarrassing things were you thinking about, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-t-there's no way I could tell you that!」
I'm truly ashamed of how I was acting just a moment ago.
And it makes me so happy to have them celebrate the day I was born like this.

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena. Please don't tease Sakura-kun too much」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes, I know, he is our precious guest, after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「Lord Synn, right this way, please」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, ah, yes!」

name: Riesling
message: 「There is no need for you to be so stiff」

name: Helena
message: 「What's getting stiff, now?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Honestly, Helena!」

name: Riesling
message: 「This party was proposed by Melilot for your sake, Lord Synn...」

name: Riesling
message: 「We, too, put our heart and soul into preparing it」

name: Riesling
message: 「We would be delighted if you would enjoy yourself to your heart's content」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Furthermore, in the unlikely event that you do not enjoy it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Daaah--!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Riesling, stop threatening him!」

name: Riesling
message: 「...My apologies.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Honestly, geez...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. I feel like I'm getting quite the enthusiastic welcome...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am terribly sorry. Was it not to your liking...?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, that's not it at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm really, truly happy」

name: Synn
message: 「I just never expected anyone to celebrate my birthday...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Is that so」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you are pleased, then nothing could make me happier」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, why go so far...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is meant as... a token of my everyday gratitude」

name: Melilot
message: 「After all, you have been working hard for us in so many ways, Sakura-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「If that's the case, then I should be the one...」

name: Helena
message: 「That's not all, you know」

name: Helena
message: 「This includes thanks from me and Tamiko-chan, too」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「I mean, Melilot of all people came out and said she wanted to celebrate someone's birthday!」

name: Helena
message: 「Isn't that just the most amazing progress♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please do not make me sound like some gloomy recluse...」

name: Riesling
message: 「However, it is an undeniable fact that Melilot has changed thanks to you, Synn-sama」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, of course that's gonna get the rest of us fired up to help out!」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is why I told you there is no need to say unnecessary things\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「So you and everyone else prepared all of this, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Um... Truth be told, I originally intended to prepare everything by myself, but...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Being quite unaccustomed to this sort of thing, you see...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「That thoughtfulness of yours makes me happier than anything, Melilot-san.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, consulting me, Helena Kujou--a born entertainer--was definitely the right call!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now that it's too late, I'm actually regretting that part...」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, Synn-chan! Starting now, it's a fabulously invincible free-for-all of drinking, eating, singing, and dancing♪」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're going way too wild right out of the gate!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Synn-sama, please have a drink.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thanks.」

name: Melilot
message: 「No alcohol allowed!」

name: Helena
message: 「C'mon, c'mooon~ Merilosh, you tooo, chug a glass~!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're already completely hammered, aren't you!?」

name: Helena
message: 「C'mooon~ Synn-chaaan, come over heeeresh~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um, wait, you're too close, and besides, that booze smell!」

name: Helena
message: 「Merilosh, you tooo~ Let me give you some good-girl pats~\s04」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyah, wait, Helena! Don't pull me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wai--ah, aaah! I told you, not there!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I won't let you escape.」

name: Helena
message: 「Guhehehehe!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Nooooo~~!」
Caught by Helena-san, Melilot-san and I get roughed up amidst her boozy breath.
Still, various parts of her feel kind of soft, so maybe it actually feels pretty good...

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, bad thoughts, bad thoughts!」
This is, well, just because the smell of alcohol made my head go fuzzy!

name: Synn
message: 「...U-Um, Melilot-san...」

name: Melilot
message: 「*Sniff*... Sakura-kun, I'm so sorry」

name: Melilot
message: 「I didn't mean for things to turn out like this, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, please don't worry about it」

name: Synn
message: 「Just being able to spend my birthday with you, Melilot-san, makes me happy」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Really?」

name: Synn
message: 「Really」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're not lying?」

name: Synn
message: 「...You have 'I know' written all over your face」

name: Melilot
message: 「...*Giggle*」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm glad」
Just being able to see Melilot-san's lovely smile like this...
Today became an even more special day to me than usual.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you so much, truly」

name: Melilot
message: 「You're welcome」
Wrapped in an atmosphere a little more mature than usual, my birthday night deepens.
Feeling how deeply precious Melilot-san is to me for caring about me this much...
I wanted to be of even more help to Melilot-san from now on.
